Trash and activity log  (/admin/trash, /admin/activity)
-------------------------------------------------------
  ✓ Table "admin_trash" (trash)
  ✓ Table "admin_activity" (activity log)
  Trash: records are kept 30 days; php flo admin:trash-purge deletes older ones (panel pages do it hourly).
  Activity log: entries are kept 365 days. The Activity page needs the permission activity.view.

Roles  (/admin/roles)
---------------------
  ✓ Table "admin_roles": no changes, the roles of config/config.php apply
  The page needs the permission roles.manage (Super Admin has it through *). php flo admin:roles lists the roles in force; php flo admin:roles-reset undoes changes.

CSV import and export  (/admin/<slug>/import, /admin/imports)
-------------------------------------------------------------
  Export: on, up to 50,000 rows a file
  ✓ Table "admin_imports"
  ✓ Table "admin_import_rows"
  Import: up to 10,000 rows and 10 MB a file, 100 rows a request, Undo for 7 days.
  The browser sends files in parts of 2 MB, so PHP's upload_max_filesize (2M) only limits pages without JavaScript.
  php flo admin:import-purge removes old upload files (panel pages do it hourly).

Forgot password  (/admin/password/forgot)
-----------------------------------------
  ✓ Table "admin_password_resets"
  ✓ Email: PHP mail(), from info@flocms.com. Check it with: php flo admin:mail-test you@example.com
  Links work once, for 60 minutes; 3 requests an hour per address, 10 per IP address.

Login security  (/admin/profile/security)
-----------------------------------------
  Off: add 'two_factor' => true and/or 'email_verification' => true to config/admin.php.

Pages  (/admin/site-pages)
--------------------------
  Off: add 'pages' => true to config/admin.php to manage the website's pages in the panel.
